reviews.text: Went here at 11.00 am this morning, and the guy at the front said “they are booked for today”. The old man that works at the front has told me before as long as it is before 1:00 so I don’t get how you fully booked at 11.  Not polite at all. They always seem to have an attitude.

I have been bringing my dog King here for over 7 years and I honestly wouldn’t trust anyone else. They are reliable, patient, and genuinely care about the dogs they work with. King always comes back looking AMAZING and I never have to worry because I know he’s in good hands. They are very organized flexible when they can be and the whole process is always smooth. Get there early they  popular for a reason! KING AND I LOVE YOUU ALL 🤍

Great looking dog afterward. Friendly staff. I warned a staff member that my dog bites because he’s in pain and has knots in his fur. His response was hilarious: “I bite too.” So I imagine they know how to deal with this so I don’t have to worry about my dog bitting someone. Highly recommended!

Took my Aussie here for the first time about a year ago and asked for a summer cut. Her vet told me not to do that again, because aussies are not supposed to be shaved because then they can’t regulate their own temperature.

Took her back to Lucy’s today and told the man at the counter what the vet said, he was very dismissive and just said “yeah they always say that.”

I was very specific about what they should do to my dog. No shaving. Take off about 2-3 inches and TRIM HER not SHAVE HER. And when he asked if I wanted to take her down to a “level 2” again like I did last time I said NO.

Went to pick her back up and she was shaved down to the same length as the first time I took her here. (the level 2 that I specifically said no to.)

Not sure how else I could’ve explained NOT TO SHAVE HER other than saying those words.

Her paws are also clearly not trimmed or cut. Not worth my $120 at all. We will not be returning to Lucy’s or recommending them to anyone else.
Best groomers in the zip code hands down !

Lucy’s Lucky Dogs did a really nice job with grooming. The staff was friendly, my dog looked clean and well cared for, and the whole visit felt smooth overall. The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that the timing was a little longer than I expected, but the quality of the service was still very good. I’d definitely come back.
refuses to take pitties (contributing to the unavoidable stigma that seems to follow them)

Refuse to work with poodles. All they want to do is skin RAZOR your dog! When I complained, the owner was indignant! He kicked me out after bringing my previous dog there for years. Then I was called a liar
SIR, I TOOK MY DOG THERE SINCE YOU WERE off METROPOLITAN AVE
A case of total disrespect . Find a place that doesn't act like all dogs matter! I  miss the little Hispanic  lady who was loving! The gentleman at the desk who handles the dogs has no love for the animals. He just takes your dog and has no interaction with the dog or customer. This place has gone down .0/10 2024 Reviews matter! Be nice to your clients. Stop RAZORing dogs because you take 50 dogs a day with no appointments! If you love your dog ...

I followed them from another location
. They're the best in nyc hand down
. Very professional and my dog loves going there

My yorkie's grooming was not as good as they normally do. I went back and they did it over perfectly with no questions asked. I realize nobody's perfect. However, their customer service was excellent! Highly recommended.

Excellent service staff, an admirable connection with the animals, loving, affectionate, and most importantly, I want to emphasize the satisfaction they get from finishing their work because they are very detail-oriented. Thank you Lucy's Groom for all your attention.

“We do not take pitbulls or big dogs”
That’s what I was told on the phone. My dogs are pit mixes but the easiest going dogs ever. They wouldn’t give me an appointment because I said the word “pit”.
I really like that they take good care of the pets.
They take walk-in’s because all they literally do is take them a bath and shave all their hair off down to the skin. They left my poor shihtzu completely bald.

I took my pup Champ here for the very first time and boy was I impressed! The staff was friendly, polite and very helpful. I recently took my dog back from a family member since he wasn’t being taken care of properly and immediately took him to be groomed as his hair very matted and he wasn’t being washed frequently. They assured me Champ was in great hands and the price surprisingly was very reasonable. I paid only $80 for a wash and blow out, low cut, nail file, ear cleaning and gland expression. I was very well pleased with their service. And it only took about maybe 2 hours give or take. They accept walk ins only and I was maybe fourth in line arriving there at about 730am. I was called to pick him about 15mins after 9am! Really great service and now we will continue coming back. Thank you Lucky Dogs for such a fast and fantastic service!
